description: EXAMPLE ONLY - copy to spark_sql_mapping.json and replace with your own entries. Maps each script path referenced by a Control-M job (source_script, exactly as it appears in the job) to the S3 location of its converted Spark SQL (target_script). Only SQL scripts (.hql/.sql) need an entry; non-SQL scripts (.ksh/.sh/.py) become Bash/Python operators and are omitted. ${SCRIPTS_BUCKET} is resolved at runtime from the Airflow Variable of the same name.
